summary: Yimutian Inc., a Chinese agricultural digital services company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K announcing a planned change to its ADS-to-Class A ordinary share ratio, from 1 ADS representing 375 ordinary shares to 1 ADS representing 6,000 ordinary shares, effective around August 27, 2026. This acts as a 16-for-1 reverse split for ADS holders. No ordinary shares will be issued or cancelled. The change is intended to increase the per-ADS trading price. This is a routine capital structure adjustment with no special-situation event.
